t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to Color-ga-lore to meet King Kaleidoscope, an expert on rainbows! Later, Nick and Sally are enjoying a picnic when they discover their last strawberry has gone missing!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally and Nick are so excited to go ice skating tomorrow that they can't fall asleep! Then, the Cat in the Hat takes the kids to meet Dr. Twiggles, the tree doctor.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are playing in their homemade Thingamajigger when the Cat arrives to take them on a real adventure! Later, The Cat takes them to meet Zhu Zhu, a giant panda!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick is trying to make his mother a surprise lunch but she keeps coming into the kitchen! Later, Nick can't remember where he put his yoyo...

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to Finola's Farm to have breakfast with Finola. After, it's Valentine's Day, and Nick and Sally disagree hotly on how to decorate the card they're making for the Cat.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally can't find their sled that's buried under the snow. Later, Nick and Sally are playing soccer when their ball goes through a hole in their net...

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally is trying to grow a flower for her mum but it just won't grow. Time to see Finola! Later, The Cat takes them to visit Rocky the Winter Wren.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick's most favourite smell is chocolate chip cookies! But what is Sally's? Later, Nick and Sally want to make really Halloween masks so Cat takes them to meet Aiya the Aye Aye.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are trying out their new, blue rubber boots but they keep getting stuck in the mud! Later, Nick has difficulty learning a "disappearing" magic trick.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Phew, it's hot outside! Cat suggests that they should visit some friends in the Dizzle-dazzle Desert to learn how to keep cool. Later, Sally, Nick, and Cat visit Themba the African elephant.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to meet Bernadette the Monarch Butterfly. Later, the kids are having fun trying out different moves when the Cat arrives to show them some cool moves of his own.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are exploring how deep they can dig in the sandbox. Later, Nick and Sally are excited to jump in the giant puddle in their backyard - but it's gone!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: It's Fish's birthday and Nick and Sally want to get him a special present... but who can they ask for ideas? Later, Nick and Sally are playing when their ball gets caught up in the branches of a tree!
